Description

The front seats may be optionally fitted with a special heating system (consisting of two heater elements located in the cushion and squab): these heat the seat to ease the discomfort of entering a cold passenger compartment in very cold weather, e.g. when the car is left outside for long periods during winter.

The heating device located on each seat consists of two resistors operated by a switch located on the side of the seat.

Once a certain temperature is reached, the heating action is automatically cut off by a thermal contact inside the device. An LED indicates when the heater is on.

The seat heating circuit is protected by a special fuse and is controlled by a relay which supplies other services controlled by the ignition. both are located on the right hand side under the facia.

The seat heating operates only whe the key is turned to MAR.
